# Task contract

Every work order declares: stable F0-F15 ID, one parent issue, dependencies, one stack, narrow owned paths, exact PRODUCT/PLAN headings, acceptance commands, risk, expected artifacts, rollback, budget/TTL impact, and prohibited actions. `**`, repository root, and reserved control paths are invalid ownership for product workers. A PR is draft, targets the declared stack base, links exactly one factory issue using `Closes #N`, lists changed paths and commands, and records no credentials.
